name: iterable-operations-with-var-mutability-tests-161bbbc0e0/basic-iterable-with-variable-mutability-v.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.array lists length, push, map, indexOf, remove, removeAll, toStream, toBase64, toBase16, fromBase64 and fromBase16, omitting forEach and filter.
Subset restrictions > Import declarations: ballerina/lang.map lists length, keys, hasKey, get and remove, omitting entries, map and filter.

Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:" lists array:map and map:keys but no array:forEach, array:filter, map:entries, map:map or map:filter.
reason: The asserted results essentially require unsupported array forEach/filter and map entries/map/filter operations, including their ordered callback side effects and captured-variable mutations. For example, testInt1 sums via array.forEach, recordTest counts filter callback executions, and testBasicMap2 transforms map entries with map/filter. These missing langlib operations suffice to classify the whole case as feature.
test_design_notes: XML map/forEach/filter are explicitly listed as supported; their presence does not remove the unsupported array/map dependencies.
